summary: Hampton County, SC lookout run by the state forestry commission; registered in 2011 as US 919 and since removed. Sources give no build date or site description.

facts.status_note: The register says the tower has been removed, with no date given; no source describes the site today

events.note: State report for July 1, 1946 to June 30, 1947 says two lookout towers were built that year, one in Hampton County near Early Branch; the Forest Lookouts site files it under Davidson
Registered April 7, 2011; nominated by Ron Stafford

evidence.supports: administered by the South Carolina Forestry Commission
tower has been removed; no date given
state report says two towers built in the year, one in Hampton County near Early Branch
evidence.quote: Only two lookout towers were constructed during the year, one of these in Hampton County near Early Branch.
Annual Report of the State Commission of Forestry, 7/1/1946-6/30/1947

notes_for_editor: No source gives a build year, a height or a site description. The Forest Lookouts site files the 1946-47 report entry under Davidson; a web search found no other source tying the Davidson name to that tower, so the link is unconfirmed. The removal date is unknown. The FFLOS elevation of 85 ft is the site elevation, not a tower height, and is not recorded as a fact.
